headline: 114 venues nationwide: Police begin election training in Bangladesh
summary: Law enforcement officers are undergoing specialized training across the country to prepare for upcoming electoral processes.
details: Bangladesh Police have commenced election-related training programs at 114 different venues across the country.
The training is designed to ensure that police personnel are well-prepared to maintain law and order during the electoral process.
These sessions focus on the operational requirements and protocols necessary for conducting a fair and secure election.
The nationwide rollout of training indicates a coordinated effort to strengthen security arrangements ahead of the polls.
caption:
Police are gearing up for the polls. Training has officially begun at 114 venues across Bangladesh.

Bangladesh Police have commenced election-related training programs at 114 different venues across the country.

headline: Man killed while saving brother-in-law in Shariatpur land dispute
summary: An auto-rickshaw driver was fatally attacked during a clash over graveyard land in Naria, leading to arson attacks on a local residence.
details: An auto-rickshaw driver named Anwar Bhuiyan (42) was killed following a dispute over graveyard land in Manakhan village, Bhumkhara Union, Naria Upazila of Shariatpur.
The conflict involved a long-standing dispute between current Union Parishad (UP) member Zahedul Dhali and former UP member Rubel Dhali, which is currently under litigation in court.
On Wednesday afternoon, an argument broke out between Zahedul and Rubel. It is alleged that Zahedul and his associates attacked Rubel with iron rods.
Anwar Bhuiyan, the brother-in-law of Rubel Dhali, intervened to save him and was allegedly hacked with sharp weapons by the attackers.
Anwar was rushed to Naria Upazila Health Complex and later transferred to Dhaka for advanced treatment, where he died on the way to the hospital on Wednesday evening.
Rubel Dhali was also injured in the attack and has been shifted to Dhaka for further medical care.
Following the news of Anwar's death, tension flared in the area, and angry locals set fire to the residence of the accused person, which was completely destroyed.
The Naria Fire Service unit extinguished the fire after an hour of effort. Shariatpur Additional Superintendent of Police Muhammad Mohiuddin Miraj stated that the accused has fled the area.
Police are currently working to arrest the suspects and are preparing to file a case regarding the incident.
caption:
A man was killed while trying to protect his brother-in-law during a violent clash over graveyard land in Shariatpur.

An auto-rickshaw driver named Anwar Bhuiyan (42) was killed following a dispute over graveyard land in Manakhan village, Bhumkhara Union, Naria Upazila of Shariatpur.

The conflict involved a long-standing dispute between current Union Parishad (UP) member Zahedul Dhali and former UP member Rubel Dhali, which is currently under litigation in court.

On Wednesday afternoon, an argument broke out between Zahedul and Rubel. It is alleged that Zahedul and his associates attacked Rubel with iron rods.

Anwar Bhuiyan, the brother-in-law of Rubel Dhali, intervened to save him and was allegedly hacked with sharp weapons by the attackers.

Anwar was rushed to Naria Upazila Health Complex and later transferred to Dhaka for advanced treatment, where he died on the way to the hospital on Wednesday evening.

Rubel Dhali was also injured in the attack and has been shifted to Dhaka for further medical care.

Following the news of Anwar's death, tension flared in the area, and angry locals set fire to the residence of the accused person, which was completely destroyed.

The Naria Fire Service unit extinguished the fire after an hour of effort. Shariatpur Additional Superintendent of Police Muhammad Mohiuddin Miraj stated that the accused has fled the area.

Police are currently working to arrest the suspects and are preparing to file a case regarding the incident.
